meta.guide_tau: Level caption:  energy (NIST, or a measurement of the last 20 years where one exists) and measured lifetime (where one exists).
meta.notes: NIST ASD already carries A values for 166 Pt I lines; of the 58 measured lines (Gough-Hannaford-Lowe 1982, Lotrian-Guern 1982) in the Kurucz list gf7800.all only 3 are missing from NIST and those are added here (derived from log gf with A = 0.66702 sigma^2 gf / (2J'+1)). Isotope shifts are nu(first) - nu(second); for the 248.792 nm line the heavier isotope lies at higher frequency. The 199Pt-198Pt shift on the same line is 0.98(48) GHz (199Pt is radioactive, not listed under isotopes). 195Pt has I = 1/2: hyperfine entries have A only. Isotope abundances in percent; abundance_unc in percent.
